name: Invoice extraction
description: Record type and ingest workflow for pulling vendor, amount, and date from invoice documents.
instructions:
1. Open this template and upload an invoice (PDF, image as text export, JSON, or CSV).
2. The system extracts vendor, amount, invoice number, and date into the Invoice record type.
3. Records are written through the ingest workflow; failures appear in the landing zone.
4. Use the public webhook link to POST JSON records from external systems (array of objects or { "records": [...] }).

fields.extraction_hint: Usually labeled Invoice # or Reference at the top of the document

fields.description: Company or person issuing the invoice
fields.extraction_hint: Vendor block or letterhead at the top
Look for Total, Amount Due, or Grand Total near the bottom
Invoice date field, often near the invoice number

workflows.name: Invoice document ingest
workflows.description: Map JSON or extracted document fields into invoice rows; unmatched records go to the landing zone.
